title: Polynomially bounded prefix language in NP
statement: Let $\ell$ be a function from binary strings to natural numbers, and let $V$ be a language in $\mathsf{P}$. Suppose the unary language consisting of the strings of $\ell(y)$ ones is polynomial-time computable, and suppose there are natural numbers $A,a$ such that $\ell(y)\le A(|y|+1)^a$ for every binary string $y$. Then the language of strings $q$ for which there is a binary string $s$ such that the marker-removed second component of $q$, followed by $s$, has length $\ell$ of the first component of $q$, and the pair encoding of that first component with this concatenation belongs to $V$, is in $\mathsf{NP}$.
